source.notes: Radiation metrics use MDPI Applied Sciences 14(16):7098 anchors; overpressure metrics use DataverseNO DOI 10.18710/X044QK EXP002 reduced pressure channels. The two metric families are retained as partial strict artifacts and do not by themselves prove full fire calibration closure.
source.title: MDPI hydrogen jet-fire radiation anchors and Dataverse EXP002 overpressure anchors

uncertainty.overpressure: 4 overpressure anchors; tolerance_rel max 0.5 from reduced EXP002 pressure-channel guard.
uncertainty.radiation: 4 radiation anchors; tolerance_rel max 0.434 from MDPI optimized multi-point-source residual guard.
